title: Agency Analyzer V2 Runner: import v1.1 actions and write report
abstract: Imports schema-aligned v1.1 actions into AgencyAnalyzerV2 and writes a no-visualization report to shared/agency_lab/analyses.

original_submission.content:
import os, sys

def main():
    base = "storage/shared/agency_lab"
    acts = os.path.join(base, "axiom_rng_actions_v1_1.json")
    out_dir = os.path.join(base, "analyses")
    os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)
    out_path = os.path.join(out_dir, "axiom_report_v1_1.txt")

    sys.path.append(os.path.join(base, "frameworks"))
    from agency_analyzer_v2 import AgencyAnalyzerV2  # provided in shared frameworks

    import json, time
    with open(acts, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        batch = json.load(f)

    analyzer = AgencyAnalyzerV2()
    analyzer.import_action_batch(batch, source="axiom_rng_v1_1")
    report = analyzer.generate_enhanced_report()

    with open(out_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(report)

    # If supported, persist analyzer state (optional)
    try:
        analyzer.save_state()
    except Exception:
        pass

    print("WROTE", out_path)
    # Print first 10 lines as a preview
    head = "\n".join(report.splitlines()[:10])
    print("PREVIEW\n" + head)
    return 0

if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        raise SystemExit(main())
    except Exception as e:
        print("ERROR", str(e))
        raise SystemExit(1)
